CML3112 A1 — Three problems one dataset

WHAT TO UPLOAD

ONE report: DOCX or selectable-text PDF is recommended. Existing PPTX-with-notes and written-notebook routes remain accepted.

WHERE TO DO THE WORK

Your report needs four sections: Problem 1, Problem 2, Problem 3, and My selected problem and dataset. For each problem explain the decision, possible inputs/target, data source, limitation and whether ML helps. Justify your selection. No coding or GitHub is required.

BEFORE SUBMITTING

Save/download the completed file(s). For notebooks, restart and run all cells first. Enter your own Student Registration Number exactly as on your university record. Leave Team ID blank for individual work.

Choose Add file > Upload, wait for the filenames, then press Submit. Keep the confirmation. Maximum 10 MB per file. A replacement before the deadline must contain the whole file set.

Do not upload the ZIP, guided_practice.ipynb, CSV data or helper scripts.

NEED HELP?

Use STUDENT_HOW_TO.md from your package for opening, saving or uploading. If access fails, keep your work and contact the lecturer.
